products.title: ReWind™ CNC Aluminum Weighted Pen & Stylus Desk Dock
products.summary: Solid 6061-T6 aircraft-grade brushed aluminum pen block with a precision-milled horizontal cradle, vertical quick-dock well, and micro-suction silicone base.
highlights: Dual-Orientation Resting Design: Display your drafting pen, fountain pen, or stylus horizontally along the milled top flute or upright in the 14.5mm vertical bore.
Monoblock 6061-T6 Billet Construction: CNC-turned and hand-brushed to a raw satin metallic sheen that resists fingerprints.
Diamond-Chamfered Rim: Smooth 45-degree entry bevel protects delicate metal, resin, and anodized pen barrels from scratching.
High-Grip Silicone Base: Full-coverage bottom elastomer pad anchors firmly to wood, glass, leather, or stone desk surfaces.
boxContents: 1× ReWind™ CNC Aluminum Weighted Pen & Stylus Desk Dock
1× Spare Micro-Suction Silicone Foot Pad

products.title: ReWind™ GlideMat Pro — Micro-Weave Precision Desk Pad (900×400mm)
products.summary: Large-format 900×400×4mm studio and gaming desk mat engineered with high-density micro-textured jacquard cloth, sub-surface flat-lock stitching, and a 4mm natural rubber base.
highlights: Calibrated X/Y Optical Tracking: High-density micro-weave surface delivers effortless glide for PTFE and glass mouse skates with pinpoint stopping power.
Recessed Sub-Surface Edge Stitching: Ultra-narrow flat-lock perimeter stitch sits below the pad surface to eliminate wrist irritation.
Spill-Repellent Nano Coating: Liquids bead up on contact and wipe clean without staining or altering surface glide.
4mm Dense Natural Rubber Core: Eliminates desk surface imperfections and dampens mechanical keyboard acoustics.
boxContents: 1× ReWind™ GlideMat Pro 900×400mm Precision Desk Pad
1× Rigid Cylinder Presentation & Storage Tube

highlights: Featherweight 50g Structural Balance: Zero-perforation solid shell engineered with thin-wall internal ribbing for effortless flick control and zero creak.

Studio-Grade Ra97+ Full-Spectrum LEDs: True-to-life color rendering reduces eye fatigue during late-night CAD, coding, and editing sessions.
